OpenSCAD WASM vendor files
==========================

Source package: openscad-wasm-prebuilt@1.2.0
NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/openscad-wasm-prebuilt
License: GPL-2.0-or-later

`openscad.js` is the prebuilt browser/runtime bundle from the package's
`dist/openscad.js`. It exposes `createOpenSCAD()`, which OpenCAD uses to render
OpenSCAD source to STL in the browser before displaying the mesh with Three.js.
